checks.name: Home: five destinations, the next story event, the starter car and today’s goal
Every destination renders inside the viewport with its primary action visible
Garage parts: an upgrade spends credits and changes the car that races
Garage tune: the setup changes the car and the bench measures it
World → event ready → a real practice lap pays credits, grades sections and earns a mastery star
Grand Prix: rivals keep their own stock cars and the finish pays a purse
Daily goals open from the home card and pay when collected
Story: event sheet → cutscene → event ready → the drive starts
School drills run in the school car and grade a medal
Cups: entering starts round one with the cup rules
Android Back closes the event-ready screen before leaving
